style.description: How this persona's generated wording sounds: what it names replaces style.yaml's. Only for an app that generates a line.

persona.description: Who the agent sounds like for this persona, as the model that words a generated line is told it (and the judge, who is speaking), in place of style.yaml's `persona`. A list of two to six is said in turn, each turn of the call worded with the next.

words.description: The word budgets it names, each in place of style.yaml's; the others are the app's. A knowledge answer's budget is its span's (spans).

voice.description: The most words a generated line may use on a call, in place of style.yaml's.

chat.description: The most words a generated line may use in a chat, in place of style.yaml's.

spans.description: A generated span's word budget for this persona, by prompt id and span (prompts.yaml's `generate.<span>.words`): each a span the app generates.

words.description: The most words the span may use for this persona, in place of its own.

prompts.description: The lines this persona words its own way, by prompt id: each one of prompts.yaml's, never one marked prescribed: true. Every other line is the app's.

text.description: The line's words for this persona, in place of prompts.yaml's `text`: said word for word (or, on a generated line, its fallback and what its wording is held to). It may name only the variables the app's own line names ({name}), and a framed line's every span. Absent: the app's text.

variants.description: The line's other wordings for this persona, said in turn, in place of the app's `variants`: only on a line said in turn (ack_intent, kb_not_found, kb_hold, kb_hold_more, a slot's own question), each with the variables of the line's text. Absent: the app's.

chat.description: The line's words on a chat for this persona, formatted as prompts.yaml's `chat` is, in place of the app's. Not on a generated line, or one with variants. Absent: the app's.

additionalProperties.description: One line's words for this persona: each part given replaces the app's, and every other part of the line (interruptible, generate, when, prescribed...) is the app's.

description: A persona: another way the app's lines sound, picked for a call or chat by app.yaml's personas.from. The default locale's lines only; what it does not name is the app's.
title: DialogWright persona file
